summary_1line: Kapila explains that Vedic rites purify the heart and, combined with righteous conduct and detachment, prepare seekers to realize Supreme Brahman and attain emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ancient sages perform a Vedic sacrifice while a serene teacher instructs disciples seated at his feet beneath the open sky.
A host of radiant Brahmanas transformed into stars and constellations shining across the night sky.
Ascetics, householders, forest hermits, and students walk different paths that converge toward a distant radiant light symbolizing Brahman.
